bias.en: Bearish · SAR flipped, broke the October lows
bias.zh: 偏空 · SAR 翻空，跌破 10 月低点

read.en: Micron fell 5.8% on Nov 2 to $833.59 (range $829.24–892.08), a third straight drop. It is below the rising 5-day ($912.92) and the falling 10-day ($901.21), 30-day ($984.44) and 100-day ($970.32), and above the rising 200-day ($749.31). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Nov 2 ($990.00), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: 美光 11月2日下跌 5.8%，收于 $833.59（区间 $829.24–892.08），为连续第三天下跌。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$912.92）以及下行的 10 日（$901.21）、30 日（$984.44）和 100 日均线（$970.32）下方，位于上行的 200 日均线（$749.31）上方。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 于 11月2日翻空（$990.00），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The drop broke the $861.6 and $849–855 supports (Oct 30, Oct 22 and Jun 9 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $849–862, then $884.7–892.1 (Oct 30 close, Nov 2 high) and $901–908 (10-day, Oct 30 high). Support is $818.7 (May 11 high), then $804 (Jul 17 low) and $738–749 (Jul 29 low, 200-day). A close above $862 would target $885–892; below $818.7, $804.

r.en: Oct 22 low $849.25, Jun 9 low $854.35, Oct 30 low $861.6, lost
